critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Runtime timing is acceptable on tablet/mobile (16.87–17.28 ms average, 0 long-frame ratio), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured midpoint is effectively identical to the endpoint at every viewport—exactly identical on mobile—rather than showing clear interpolation from opacity 1/transform none to opacity 0.45 with the 3D transform. That does not prove polished, continuous motion.
critique.fix: Correct or retime the animation so intermediate samples show clear eased progression instead of reaching the final state by midpoint. Then remeasure at several timestamps and optimize desktop rendering toward a consistent ~16.7 ms frame budget while retaining the verified reduced-motion override.
